note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_token)
content = note['content']
print('note_title', note['title'], 'content_len', len(content))
lines = content.splitlines()
# Extract titles that precede a line with 'director: Peter Jackson'
selected=[]
seen=set()
prev_title=None
for line in lines:
    s=line.strip()
    if not s:
        continue
    # Title lines in this note appear as plain text (not starting with '-' and not the header)
    if (not s.startswith('-')) and s.lower() not in ['# movie recommendations','movie recommendations']:
        # update prev_title candidate
        prev_title = s
    if s.lower().startswith('- director:') and 'peter jackson' in s.lower():
        if prev_title and prev_title not in seen:
            selected.append(prev_title)
            seen.add(prev_title)

print('selected_count', len(selected))
print('selected_titles', selected)
print('<reflection>Parsed the note and extracted titles associated with director: Peter Jackson.</reflection>')
